image_refs={row['view_name']:row['image_ref'] for row in images}; image_refs['TOP']='image-04'
surfaces=[]; global_offset=0
for oi,obj in enumerate(geometry['objects']):
 vertices=np.array(obj['vertices'],dtype=float)
 if oi==11:break
 for first in range(0,len(obj['triangles']),2):
  local=[first,first+1]; indices=sorted(set(sum([obj['triangles'][idx] for idx in local],[])))
  points=vertices[indices];center=points.mean(axis=0)
  tri=vertices[obj['triangles'][first]];normal=np.cross(tri[1]-tri[0],tri[2]-tri[0]);normal/=np.max(np.abs(normal))
  matches=[r for r in regions if r['object_index']==oi and np.allclose(center,np.array(r['center_world_m'],float))]
  assert len(matches)==1
  region=matches[0]
  assert np.allclose(normal,[float(Fraction(x)) for x in region['front_direction_world']])
  surfaces.append({'object_index':oi,'object':obj['name'],'local':local,'global':[global_offset+idx for idx in local],'center':center.tolist(),'corners':points.tolist(),'front':normal.tolist(),'region':region})
 global_offset+=len(obj['triangles'])
triangle_to_surface={tri:i for i,s in enumerate(surfaces) for tri in s['global']}
def pixel_stats(view):
 frame=buffers[view]; ids=frame['triangle_ids']; merged=np.full(ids.shape,-1,dtype=int)
 for tid,sid in triangle_to_surface.items(): merged[ids==tid]=sid
 color=frame['color'].astype(float); boundary=np.zeros(ids.shape,bool)
 for axis in [0,1]:
  before=(slice(None,-1),slice(None)) if axis==0 else (slice(None),slice(None,-1))
  after=(slice(1,None),slice(None)) if axis==0 else (slice(None),slice(1,None))
  mask=(merged[before]!=merged[after]) & (np.linalg.norm(color[before]-color[after],axis=2)>=24)
  boundary[before]|=mask;boundary[after]|=mask
 return [(int(np.sum(merged==sid)),int(np.sum((merged==sid)&boundary))) for sid in range(len(surfaces))]
stats={view:pixel_stats(view) for view in image_refs}
for sid,s in enumerate(surfaces):
 r=s['region'];status=r['status']
 witness=None
 if status=='covered':
  px=dict(zip(obs['pixels']['columns'],obs['pixels']['rows'][r['complete_witness_pixel_index']]))
  view=images[px['image_index']]['view_name']; counts=stats[view][sid]
  assert counts[0]>=16 and counts[1]>=4
  witness=(view,*counts);s['witness']=witness
 print(s['object_index'],s['local'],r['status'],witness or r['unobserved_reason'])
for label,view,x,y in [('sample_A','TOP',135,175),('sample_B','LEFT',234,483)]:
 tid=int(buffers[view]['triangle_ids'][y,x]);s=surfaces[triangle_to_surface[tid]]
 print('TARGET',label,'global_triangle',tid,'object',s['object'],'local',s['local'],'center',s['center'],'corners',s['corners'],'front',s['front'],'witness',s.get('witness'),'ref',image_refs[view])
print('REFERENCE_MAP',image_refs)
print('counts',len(surfaces),sum(s['region']['status']=='covered' for s in surfaces))
